unresolved_gaps: The retrieved records do not establish an industry-wide absence of durable competitive advantages.
Multiple price reductions do not by themselves establish repeated rival-responsive cuts.
The contribution of weak barriers has not been separated from technical efficiency improvements and changes in product quality.
